verdict.rationale: Forter documents a first-party way to flag agentic orders in the Order API: set orderType to AI_AGENT and send transaction source and metadata, which Forter says improves its risk decisions. Nothing shows that verified identity artifacts are accepted or validated as signals, so only the agent-source part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: signed agent token ingestion/verification, agentic-payment protocol support, delegated spending scope fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal

citations.quote: Set orderType to AI_AGENT ... This additional data improves Forter's risk decisions and provides the merchant better reporting on agentic traffic.

When a merchant receives an order from a consumer's agent (e.g. ChatGPT or Gemini), they should call the Forter API with additional data, signaling Forter the transaction source as well as transaction metadata
